title: Research interests
description: Exploring how complex quantum systems evolve,
interact with their environments, and encode information.

items.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics
items.description: Understanding the dynamics of quantum many-body systems far from equilibrium, including their relaxation, transport, and emergent behavior.

items.title: Open quantum systems
items.description: Studying quantum systems coupled to their environments, with particular interest in dissipation, decoherence, and non-Hermitian phenomena.

items.title: Information, computation & AI
items.description: Exploring how information theory and probability can deepen our understanding of quantum dynamics, how AI can support theoretical discovery, and how physics can inform quantum computing and learning.
